embeds.title: Day 8 shipped — multi-unit incidents · Tier 2 lands · Phase 2 in flight
embeds.description: The dispatch FSM goes class-aware. An MVA needs **engine + ambulance** on scene before the resolution timer starts; a structure fire needs **engine + ladder**; a police assault needs **patrol + ambulance**. Tier 2 ships denser pacing (14 min, 6 incidents) and introduces police calls. Roster expanded to 4 unit classes.

fields.name: Build
fields.value: tsc clean · 69/69 tests · vite 13s · 531 KB gz

fields.name: Schema
fields.value: `ShiftIncident.required_units: VehicleClass[]` (default `[]`) — flows into `Incident.required_unit_classes`. New `Incident.dwell_started_at_game_min` records when the requirement was first satisfied. Empty array = legacy single-unit behavior, fully backwards-compatible.

fields.name: FSM rewrite (`tickStep` Phase 3)
fields.value: Split into 3a (per-incident dwell-start gate via `requirementMet()`) and 3b (window-elapsed → resolve + send ALL on-scene units home). Class-lookup goes Unit → Vehicle.class, so the FsmContext now carries `vehicles`.

fields.name: Roster expanded
fields.value: **E1** engine · **L1** ladder · **M1** ambulance_als · **P1** patrol — all from Davenport Central, all available at boot. 6 personnel: lieutenant, 2 firefighters, paramedic, EMT, officer.

fields.name: Tier 2 shift (`qc_tier2_001.yaml`)
fields.value:
14 game-min · 6 incidents · denser pacing, multi-unit-heavy:
• T+0.5 police_traffic [patrol]
• T+2.0 medical_cardiac [ambulance]
• T+4.0 rescue_motor_vehicle [engine + ambulance]
• T+6.5 police_assault [patrol + ambulance]
• T+8.5 fire_residential **CRITICAL** [engine + ladder]
• T+11.0 alarm_false [engine]

fields.name: Dossier requirement chip
fields.value: Selecting an incident with `required_units` shows a new "REQUIRED UNITS" section: each class lists `✓ on scene` (emerald) or `— pending` (amber). A live "dwell since" row appears once the timer starts.

fields.name: Tests
fields.value: **69/69 pass.** Day 8 added 4 multi-unit tests: engine-only-doesn't-start-dwell · both-on-scene-starts-dwell · full-cycle-through-resolution · legacy-single-unit-still-works. Existing 65 tests untouched (backwards-compat verified by Zod default).

fields.name: Day 9 next
fields.value: Pick from: **(a)** shift picker UI (Tier 1 vs Tier 2 from a menu) · **(b)** multi-station roster + agency-aware closest-unit dispatch · **(c)** save/replay verbs · **(d)** full QC bbox tile-and-merge.
